simulator.heading: WhatsApp simulator
simulator.intro: A local stand-in for a phone on the WhatsApp Business Platform. Messages go through the real webhook path, signed with the local app secret, and replies appear as the API sends them.
simulator.clockAdvanced: (25 hours later: the 24-hour service window has closed)
simulator.pollingPaused: Checking for replies paused after 15 minutes without activity.
simulator.sendFailed: The message could not be sent to the API.
simulator.tipSigned: Each message is signed like a Meta delivery and accepted durably before processing.
simulator.tipWindow: After "Advance clock", replies are sent as an approved template, as Meta requires outside the 24-hour window.
simulator.unavailableBody: It only runs locally with WHATSAPP_MODE=simulator.

privacy.heading: Privacy notice (demo)
privacy.intro: PolicyPilot is a portfolio demo for a fictional insurance agency. Do not enter real personal information. This notice describes how the software handles data so the design can be reviewed.

who.title: Who runs this assistant
who.body: Harbor & Pine Insurance Agency is fictional, and so are its carriers, products and rates. The assistant is an AI that gives information and estimates; licensed agents handle advice and approve every application.

what.title: What is stored
what.body: Your messages, after card, bank, ID numbers and health details are removed; the needs you describe; quotes; and, only if you apply or ask to be contacted, your name and contact details together with a record of your consent.

models.title: AI models
models.body: Replies are written by a language model through the Claude API, with an OpenAI model as a fallback when it is enabled. Your contact details are never sent to a model. Prices are never produced by a model; they come from the rating engine.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.body: Inactive conversations close after 30 days, pending reviews expire after 14 days, closed conversations are deleted after 180 days, and sales records after 24 months unless the sale was won.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: The agency can export or erase everything stored about a conversation, including the assistant's working memory. Erasure also signs out every device that holds the conversation.

demo.title: This demo
demo.body: Without an API key the assistant is a scripted demo and no data leaves the machine it runs on. WhatsApp messages in the simulator never reach Meta.
